product.name: Classic Cushion Cover - Mustard Diamonds - 45x45cm
product.description: Add a bold yet timeless accent to your home with the Classic Cushion Cover – Mustard Diamonds. Featuring a striking diamond pattern in warm mustard tones, this cushion instantly brings energy and style to any space.
product.description_extra:
The geometric design offers a perfect balance between modern and boho aesthetics, making it easy to pair with both neutral and colourful interiors. Whether styled on a sofa, bed, or accent chair, it creates a fresh focal point while still feeling cosy and inviting.

Ideal for layering with other textures or using as a statement piece, this cushion cover is a simple way to refresh your décor with warmth, pattern, and contemporary charm.

information.text:
We kindly ask all trade customers to check their orders upon receipt and report any issues within 3 working days.

If an item arrives damaged, faulty, or is missing, or if you received something by mistake, we’ll resolve it swiftly—typically via store credit, replacement, or refund.

For voluntary returns of unwanted items, notify us within 14 days, and return them in resalable condition (buyer covers return postage).
